name: voice-of-customer-datalake
description: Voice of the Customer Data Lake - Unified customer feedback intelligence platform

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix voc-datalake && npm install --prefix voc-datalake/frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:cdk && npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:stream && npm run lint:gates && npm run lint:python
scripts.lint:python: cd voc-datalake && .venv/bin/python -m ruff check lambda plugins scripts
scripts.typecheck:cdk: cd voc-datalake && npx tsc --noEmit && npx tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json --noEmit
scripts.typecheck:all: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:cdk && npm run typecheck:stream
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck:all && npm run test && npm run check:mock && npm run check:i18n && npm run build && npm run test:cdk && npm run test:stream && npm run test:backend
scripts.check:i18n: cd voc-datalake/frontend && node scripts/i18n-check.test.mjs && node --test scripts/set-nested.test.mjs && node scripts/i18n-check.mjs
scripts.test:audit: voc-datalake/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -c scripts/audit/pytest.ini scripts/audit && node --test scripts/audit/*.test.mjs
scripts.lint:audit: cd voc-datalake && .venv/bin/python -m ruff check --config ruff.toml ../scripts/audit && cd .. && node_modules/.bin/pyright --pythonpath voc-datalake/.venv/bin/python -p scripts/audit/pyrightconfig.json
scripts.generate:config: npm run generate:manifests && npm run generate:menu
scripts.deploy:all: npm run check && npm run deploy:infra && npm run deploy:frontend
